sentences: I looked at the array 3,4,1,2, found the smallest number 1, swapped it to the front, and since one pass checks everything the array became 1,2,3,4.
First I scanned all four values, saw 1 is smallest, moved it to a[0], then the remaining numbers 2,3,4 just fell into order as I kept going.
Starting from the beginning, I compared each element, found 1, swapped it forward, and after that single exchange the whole list looked sorted from smallest to largest.
Selection sort finds the smallest and puts it first, so I picked 1 for a[0], then the rest 2,3,4 naturally arrange themselves in increasing order after just this one step.
The pass found 1 as minimum and swapped with 3, giving 1,4,3,2, but since scanning covers all positions the final sorted array becomes 1,2,3,4 as I listed.
